I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I didn't set up the recurring digest.

The reason: scheduled jobs created from this session are local-only and don't post back into Slack, so a Monday 08:00 post wouldn't happen. I told her I can write the digest by hand on request, from #coastal-team and #coastal-random only, with finance figures left out. Automating it needs IT or Ruth Calloway to set up a scheduler that posts to Slack.
